verdict.rationale: Mollie documents an official hosted MCP server at mcp.mollie.com/mcp. Its docs say it lets merchants use AI tools like Claude Desktop and Cursor to 'utilize natural language for creating different resources' across 13 APIs (Payments, Payment Links, Subscriptions, Customers, Balances and others), with scoped tokens and documented client configs. Natural-language operation goes through third-party AI clients rather than an in-product assistant, and the covered API set is limited. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language interface, coverage beyond the listed APIs (e.g. refunds, chargebacks, Connect), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Mollie MCP server enables merchants to use various AI tools like Claude Desktop and Cursor AI to utilize natural language for creating different resources in their Mollie account.

Currently, the following APIs are available: Balances API, Captures API, Customers API, Invoices API, Mandates API, Methods API, Payments API, Payment Links API, Settlements API, Subscriptions API, Terminals API, Webhooks API, Webhook Events API.
